payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of baseline models used in the context of SQL generation, detailing their adaptations and performance metrics, which qualifies them as state-of-the-art baselines.

claims.text: The state-of-the-art baselines include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for context-dependent SQL generation.
Recent models achieving state-of-the-art performance include those using recursive decoding and graph neural networks, as well as an intermediate representation for bridging natural language and SQL.
The model achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art results from IRNet with BERT, indicating its competitive nature in the field.
